data.title: After the group meeting
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Thanks for staying after the group meeting. I'm Noor Haddad, I run the humidity sensor array at the Fenwick Institute. Speaker 2: Of course. You wanted the cleaned logs from the rooftop sensors? Speaker 1: Yes, please, before Thursday's group meeting, so I can show the drift plots. Speaker 2: I'll send you the cleaned logs before Thursday. Speaker 1: Great. And I've asked the workshop to book the climate chamber for us; they said they'd confirm by Monday. Speaker 2: Then I'll chase them if we haven't heard by Monday. Speaker 1: Perfect.
